arxiv-2012-08387.title: Run, Forest, Run? On Randomization and Reproducibility in Predictive Software Engineering
arxiv-2012-08387.creator: Cynthia C. S. Liem, Annibale Panichella
arxiv-2012-08387.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Cynthia C. S. Liem, Annibale Panichella. Machine learning (ML) has been widely used in the literature to automate software engineering tasks. However, ML outcomes may be sensitive to randomization in data sampling mechanisms and learning procedures. To understand whether and how researchers in SE address these threats, we surveyed 45 recent papers related to three predictive tasks: defect prediction (DP), predictive mutation testing (PMT), and code smell detection (CSD).

arxiv-2112-07989.title: Origin of postmaximum bump in luminous type Ic SN 2019stc 2021 Origin of postmaximum bump in luminous type Ic SN 2019stc – References
arxiv-2112-07989.creator: Nikolai N. Chugai, Victor P. Utrobin
arxiv-2112-07989.description: Abstract We address the issue of the postmaximum bump observed in the light curve of some superluminous supernovae. We rule out the popular mechanism of a circumstellar interaction suggested for the bump explanation. Instead we propose that the postmaximum bump is caused by the magnetar dipole field enhancement several months after the explosion.

arxiv-2402-11272.title: Many-body localization properties of fully frustrated Heisenberg spin-1/2 ladder model with next-nearest-neighbor interaction
arxiv-2402-11272.creator: Jiameng Hong, Taotao Hu
arxiv-2402-11272.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jiameng Hong, Taotao Hu. Many-body localization (MBL) is an intriguing physical phenomenon that arises from the interplay of interaction and disorder, allowing quantum systems to prevent thermalization. In this study, we investigate the MBL properties of the fully frustrated Heisenberg spin-1/2 ladder model with next-nearest-neighbor hopping interaction along the leg direction and compare it with the Heisenberg spin-1/2 single-chain model with next-nearest-neighbor hopping interaction. We explore the MBL transition using random matrix theory and study the characteristics of entanglement entropy and its variance.

arxiv-2410-23207.title: Enhancing Autonomous Driving Safety Analysis with Generative AI: A Comparative Study on Automated Hazard and Risk Assessment
arxiv-2410-23207.creator: Alireza Abbaspour, Aliasghar Arab *, Yashar Mousavi
arxiv-2410-23207.description: Abstract The advent of autonomous driving technology has accentuated the need for comprehensive hazard analysis and risk assessment (HARA) to ensure the safety and reliability of vehicular systems. Traditional HARA processes, while meticulous, are inherently time-consuming and subject to human error, necessitating a transformative approach to fortify safety engineering.

arxiv-2412-09362.title: Falcon-UI: Understanding GUI Before Following User Instructions
arxiv-2412-09362.creator: Huawen Shen Chang Liu Gengluo Li Xinlong Wang Yu Zhou Can Ma Xiangyang Ji
arxiv-2412-09362.description: Abstract Pursuing human-like interaction for Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents requires understanding the GUI context and following user instructions. However, existing works typically couple these two aspects and focus more on instruct-following abilities, while ignoring the importance of understanding the GUI context.

arxiv-2503-24108.title: PolypSegTrack: Unified Foundation Model for Colonoscopy Video Analysis
arxiv-2503-24108.creator: Anwesa Choudhuri, Zhongpai Gao, Meng Zheng, Benjamin Planche, Terrence Chen, Ziyan Wu
arxiv-2503-24108.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anwesa Choudhuri, Zhongpai Gao, Meng Zheng, Benjamin Planche, Terrence Chen, Ziyan Wu. Early detection, accurate segmentation, classification and tracking of polyps during colonoscopy are critical for preventing colorectal cancer. Many existing deep-learning-based methods for analyzing colonoscopic videos either require task-specific fine-tuning, lack tracking capabilities, or rely on domain-specific pre-training. In this paper, we introduce PolypSegTrack , a novel foundation model that jointly addresses polyp detection, segmentation, classification and unsupervised tracking in colonoscopic videos.

arxiv-2505-19177.creator: Gabriele Giannone
arxiv-2505-19177.description: Abstract . A system of two singular semi–linear elliptic equations, patterned after the Schrödinger-Maxwell system, is considered. If the reaction term of the first equation contains a datum f ∈ L m f\in L^{m} , existence of positive solutions with finite energy is established for suitable ranges of m m .

pmc-10537134.description: Four-dimensionally printed continuous carbon fiber-reinforced shape memory polymer composite (CFSMPC) is a smart material with the ability to bear loads and undergo deformation. In this study, the effect of temperature on the shape memory recovery performance of polylactic acid (PLA) was first studied experimentally.

pmc-11438403.description: BackgroundThe healthcare sector has a negative ecological impact, and intensive care is one of the most resource-consuming areas. pmc-12552425.title: Design and test analysis of a rotary cutter device for root cutting of golden needle mushroom
pmc-12552425.creator: Limin Xie, Yuxuan Gao, Zhiqiang Lin, Feifan He, Wenxin Duan, Dapeng Ye
pmc-12552425.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). To address the issues of poor harvesting efficiency, unsatisfactory cutting performance, and high energy consumption in current golden needle mushroom harvesting machinery, this study designed a novel rotary cutter-type root cutting device featuring a slitting cutting angle cutter. The device utilizes a clamping mechanism on a feed turntable to secure the mushrooms, with root cutting achieved through synchronized rotation of the rotary cutter and the turntable.

pmc-12712522.title: Repair of a Chronic Quadriceps Tendon Re-rupture With Semitendinosus Tendon Autograft Augmentation
pmc-12712522.creator: Benjiman J Wilebski, Luke V Tollefson, Dustin R Lee, Matthew T Rasmussen, Robert F LaPrade
pmc-12712522.description: The quadriceps tendon (QT) functions as one of the primary knee extensor mechanisms. The risk of QT tendinopathy increases with age, which also impacts the risk of QT rupture. This injury typically occurs as a result of an abrupt eccentric contraction with knee hyperflexion. A QT rupture has detrimental effects on quality of life and function.

pmc-12992533.title: MobiPhysio: A 2D video dataset of physiotherapy exercises for AI-driven assessment and monitoring
pmc-12992533.creator: Md. Tauhid Bin Iqbal, Md. Tawhid Mostafa, Md. Tanvir Ahmed, Md. Faiaz Fahim, Md. Sagir Ahmed, Anik Ahamad, Khawja Redwanul Islam, Byungyong Ryu, Gihun Song, Md. Zahid Hossain
pmc-12992533.description: We present MobiPhysio, a 2D video-based dataset designed to support AI-driven physiotherapy assessment and monitoring. The dataset contains 3686 segmented videos of 9 Active Range of Motion physiotherapy exercises performed by 58 male and female participants. The recordings are done under the variations in lighting, camera angles, occlusion, and jitter in order to mimic real-world conditions.

pmc-13214337.creator: Ahmed R Alfarhan, Akihiro Matsukawa, Angelo Cormio, Marcin Miszczyk, Abdulrahman A Alhazeem, Abdulrahman S Alqathtani, Alessandro Dematteis, Ichiro Tsuboi, Navid Roessler, Takafumi Yanagisawa, Jun Miki, Piotr Chłosta, Pierre I Karakiewicz, Takahiro Kimura, Shahrokh F Shariat
pmc-13214337.description: Take Home MessageRobotic-assisted radical cystectomy is linked with a 47% higher risk of ureteral-ileal anastomotic strictures compared to open surgery, highlighting the need for vigilant postoperative monitoring. Intracorporeal urinary diversion shows a modestly increased stricture risk versus extracorporeal diversion overall, but this difference disappears when limited to robotic cases, suggesting selection and surgical approach interplay.
